Upstream GCC commit 5d419c69ce2e6b86d7da75f18736904885674219 (PR libstdc++/124370) stops std::bitset wide-character stream extraction from sizing its buffer without sizeof(wchar_t). The fix is backported to Debian's gcc-14 14.2.0-19 source for trixie, re-expressed against the 14.2.0 operator>>. Debian trixie has not published the fix; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-115455

Upstream GCC commit 2fd8866591b5aea7098835f80ab7e176382175ae makes std::vector<bool> constructors check the element count against max_size() before sizing the bit array, so the word count cannot wrap. The fix is backported to Debian's gcc-14 14.2.0-19 source for trixie, without the from_range constructor hunk, which GCC 14.2.0 does not have. Debian trixie has not published the fix; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-114691

Debian security tracker: fixed in unstable by the same change as CVE-2026-85091, which is upstream zlib commit df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148. That change resets the stream input pointer and available input after a failed write() in gz_write(), so a later gz* write cannot use the stale caller buffer. This package build includes an adaptation of that upstream change for the zlib 1.3.1 code base. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-76844

The covered package builds prevent a failed direct-buffer gzwrite from leaving a caller-owned input pointer available to gzprintf or gzvprintf. They either guard the later formatting entry points or include the pointer-state reset from upstream commit https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148 in the equivalent zlib 1.3.1 error branch. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-85091.

Loki 2.9.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. v0.311.3 drops github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which Loki 2.9.x still imports from pkg/ingester. Reachability of the legacy heatmap render path on the Loki 2.9 binary has not been verified to match the 3.7 not_affected analysis. Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping this track.

CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28) is a stored XSS in the Prometheus server's legacy web UI heatmap, which is only rendered when the prometheus binary is launched with --enable-feature=old-ui. Loki 2.9.x imports github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web/api/v1 only for the PrometheusVersion struct (version reporting in pkg/loki/version_handler.go and pkg/util/build/build.go); the legacy web UI templates and heatmap render path are not imported or compiled into the Loki binary. Loki 2.9.x cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which pkg/ingester still imports.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server's remote-read HTTP handler (/api/v1/read), which uses a snappy decoder that does not validate declared payload length before allocating memory. Loki 2.9.x uses github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote only on the client side (pkg/ruler/storage/instance/instance.go calls remote.NewStorage for the ruler WAL) and never instantiates remote.NewReadHandler or routes /api/v1/read in its HTTP server, so the vulnerable handler is not reachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7.x has the same client-only remote storage posture. Loki 2.9.x cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which pkg/ingester still imports. Loki 3.7.x cannot take the v0.311.3 bump because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

Loki 3.6.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. Bumping to 0.311.3 is source incompatible with Loki 3.6.x and 2.9. Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping this track.

Loki 2.9.x and 3.6.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. The fixed Prometheus line in 3.7 drops github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which these Loki lines still import, and further source incompatibilities appear after patching that import (labels.Labels, chunkenc.Iterator, and PromQL parser API changes). Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping these tracks.
